title: Claude Buddy — F24/F23 frame Unicode Hex Input

rules.description: F24 unconditionally selects Unicode Hex Input. Sent by the firmware at the start of each PTT capture so the board can type Hangul as Option+hex regardless of what input source the user was in. Idempotent (no-op if already in UHI).

F23 unconditionally selects the user's primary layout (Korean by default; change `language` to `en` etc. for other defaults). Sent by the firmware at the end of each PTT capture so the host returns from UHI even if PTT started while already in UHI.
